Ha ho na app e ka sebetsang le kopo ena.
Sheba software ea mohloli o bulehileng le laesense tse kenyelelitsoeng ka har’a app.
Bala melao-motheo ea tšebeletso ea Dambom .

Khoasolla feela livideo tsa sechaba, tse sa tsoa tsoa ho DRM tseo u nang le tumello ea ho boloka.
Kopa aterese ea leqephe la video ho Home, batla livideo, \'me u khethe seo u batlang ho se boloka.
2. Arolelana ho tsoa ho Chrome kapa X
Khetha Dambom lenaneng la ho arolelana la app e \'ngoe, netefatsa sehokelo, \'me u qale ho batla livideo.
Bula matheba a marang-rang a mangata, bapala video ho leqephe le teng hajoale, ebe u tobetsa Detect video.
Sheba tsoelo-pele ea mola, \'me u emise, u tsoelepele, u hlakole, kapa u lebetse download ka \'ngoe.

Ha u tloha ha video ea lehae e felile e ntse e bapala skrineng se felletseng, ho bapala ho tsoela pele ho PiP lisebelisoa tse tšehetsang. Lividio tse ka hare, tse emisitsoeng, kapa tse haellang ha li kena ka bo eona, \'me ha ho fanoa ka tšebeletso ea ho bapala ka morao.
